arguments.value: 40-year-old Asian man with recurrent left-sided foul-smelling nasal discharge and orbital/facial pain due to chronic left maxillary sinus cholesteatoma. After prior ESS and later Caldwell-Luc surgery, he developed a lesion near the nasolacrimal duct; biopsy confirmed well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma of the left maxillary sinus/nasolacrimal duct region, stage II (T2N0M0), treated with wide excision followed by adjuvant chemoradiotherapy with no recurrence at 1-year follow-up.
